en: 2 Toei line disruption(s) are active right now, including: Oedo Line: service suspended between Roppongi and Azabu-Juban; Asakusa Line: signal fault causing ~10 min delays. 39 earthquakes were recorded in the Tokyo area over the past 7 days, none above minor intensity. No JMA weather warnings are active in the 23 wards.
ja: 現在、都営線で2件の運行情報があります。過去7日間に39件の地震が観測されました。23区内でJMA気象警報・注意報の発表はありません。
